fields.description:
**Context**
Once the ops "New" button exists (see linked ticket), ops needs a usable flow to manually enter a full VIP sign-up — including creating the Player record itself, since these players don't already exist in Salesforce.

**Requirements**

* Support creating the Player directly from the same lookup field used when creating a sign-up (mirror the existing Referrer lookup-create pattern: choose an existing player, or create one inline from the lookup).
* All standard sign-up fields should be available, same as regular (non-VIP) intake, plus the VIP flag (see separate VIP flag/indicator ticket). Conditional fields (e.g. Fraud Details) stay hidden unless/until those options are actually selected, same as today.
* Build as a restrictive custom screen flow (not the full Ops edit-view field layout) so only the relevant fields for manual VIP entry are shown, independent of the standard Ops edit view.
* Status: on manual creation, default directly to "In Progress" — no "New"/pending state, since this isn't coming from automated intake. Move to "Completed" or "Archived" from there using the existing status values; no new status values needed.
* Player ID / external ID should be left blank for VIP-created players — these don't flow through the CMS integration or receive CMS survey callouts, so there's no external ID to populate. Primary Email remains the fallback unique identifier if a lookup is ever needed later.
* Sign-up must be relatable to an existing Deal (the deal will already exist by the time ops logs the sign-up) — confirm the related-list/relationship UX once the New button and flow are in place.
* VIP sign-ups follow the same proof-collection flow as standard sign-ups (Joyce confirmed VIP sign-ups do collect the same screenshots/proof) — no differences needed there.

**Constraints / Dependencies**
Depends on "Player: Add manual Sign-Up creation button for Ops (VIP)" being built first. Volume is low (\~30 sign-ups total under this program per Joyce) — not designed for bulk upload.

**Source**
Fathom — WagerTech <> Jumpr Weekly Sync, 09/23/2026 (https://fathom.video/calls/831090060) — Joyce Kiddell \~54:43–1:02:56, Kobi Kunasekaran \~55:26–1:10:39, Emily Vandenberg \~1:01:53–1:10:39. Also Taryn's notes, Joyce VIP section (full page).
